2026-07-25 Japan

Japan Day 1

Sebastian here!

Off to Japan

Left our hotel at 6am for the airport, which meant we had little sleep. Sad to say goodbye to China, but we were really excited to go to Japan.

We had breakfast at KFC! It always amazes me how different the menus of restaurant chains are around the world are.

Going through migration was a breeze (phew!), which was great as I don't need to worry about visas for the rest of the trip.

Osaka

With minor hiccups we were able to get from the aiport to downtown Osaka. We are missing how easy it was to get around the city with perfectly labelled signs in China. We are hoping the rest of Japan is better, lol. We only planned to be there for the afternoon, so we knew we were not going to be able to do a lot. We spent most of our time there in Dotonbori (Time's square of Osaka). Dotonbori was very interesting, but packed with people (a little overwhelming).

We had lunch at a conveyor belt sushi restaurant! The whole experience was super fun and the food was great.

For dinner we had Okonomiyaki (savory pancake dish), Takoyaki (octopus balls), and Kushikatsu (deep-fried skewered meat), all Osaka's specialties!

Kyoto

After a long day and a short visit of Osaka, we took the train to Kyoto and will explore it tomorrow!
